title: NYRR Prize Money — 2026 TCS New York City Marathon division purses and event records
claims: The 2026 TCS New York City Marathon is listed as a World Athletics Elite Platinum Label race under World Athletics Rules.
To be eligible for prize money in any category, a runner must complete the course in 3 hours 10 minutes or faster.

Open Division purse (men and women equal, Professional/Invited Athlete start, Gun Time): 1st $100,000, 2nd $60,000, 3rd $40,000, 4th $25,000, 5th $15,000, 6th $10,000, 7th $7,500, 8th $5,000, 9th $2,500, 10th $2,000.
USA Division purse: 1st $25,000, 2nd $15,000, 3rd $10,000, 4th $5,000, 5th $3,000; Masters Division (40+) purse: 1st $3,000, 2nd $2,000, 3rd $1,000.
A $50,000 record bonus is paid to the Open Division and/or Wheelchair Division race winner who breaks, not ties, the existing event record on Gun Time.

Event records listed on the NYRR prize-money page: Open Men 2:04:58 Tamirat Tola 2023; Open Women 2:19:51 Hellen Obiri 2025; Wheelchair Men 1:25:26 Marcel Hug 2022; Wheelchair Women 1:39:32 Catherine Debrunner 2023.
